#### List:

- Washout modelling
- Uptake
- Elimination

#### Emergence modelling:

+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Description    | - Multiphasic: distribution then terminal elimination                                                                                                                          |
|                | - Exponential decay: rate of removal ∝ partial pressure                                                                                                                        |
|                | - Fairly rapid: moderate solubility → context-sensitive decrement times                                                                                                        |
|                | - Pulmonary excretion 95-98% \>\> hepatic metabolism 2-5%                                                                                                                      |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Determinants   | 1.  Uptake (into all compartments)                                                                                                                                             |
|                | 2.  Elimination (via central compartment)                                                                                                                                      |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Kinetic model  | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2014/A/9/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Compartment model connecting vessel-rich, lean, intermediate, vessel-poor and fat tissues"}                     |
|                |                                                                                                                                                                                |
|                | **Drug solubility:**                                                                                                                                                           |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                |                                                          | **Desflurane**                                           | **Sevoflurane**                                          |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                | Muscle:blood                                             | 2.0                                                      | 3.1                                                      |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                | Fat:blood                                                | 29                                                       | 48                                                       |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                | **Compartment saturation:**                                                                                                                                                    |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                |                                                          | **Capacity**                                             | **Equilibration time (3τ)**                              |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                | V~1~                                                     | Low                                                      | Complete (17 mins)                                       |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                | V~2~                                                     | Moderate                                                 | Near complete (7 hours)                                  |
|                +----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
|                | V~3~                                                     | High                                                     | Minimal (5.4 days)                                       |
+----------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------+
| Washout curve  | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2014/A/9/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Sevoflurane washout curve showing alveolar fraction relative to its initial value against time"}                |

| Decrement time | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2014/A/9/prize-image003.jpg){fig-alt="Comparison of 90% decrement times for sevoflurane and desflurane against duration of administration"}           |

#### 1.Uptake (factors increasing it)

+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Administration | - ↑Duration                                                             |
|                | - ↑Inspired concentration (↑MAC in children)                            |
+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Patient        | - ↑Cardiac output → ↑tissue blood flow (child, pregnant, obese, septic) |
|                | - ↑Compartment volumes → ↑capacity (lean tissue, fat)                   |
+----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### 2.Elimination (factors slowing it)

+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Tissue → blood      | - ↑Redistribution rate                           |
|                     |   - ↑Tissue blood flow = ↑cardiac output (major) |
|                     |   - ↑Compartment volumes                         |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Blood → alveolus    | - ↓Cardiac output (minor)                        |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Alveolus → circuit  | - ↓Ratio V~A~:FRC                                |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
| Circuit → exhaust   | - ↓Ratio FGF rate : circuit volume               |
|                     | - ↓Inspired concentration                        |
+---------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
